findings.passage: HB 458: Governor DeWine signed HB 458 into law last week. This new bill makes an Ohio driver’s license, state ID card, military ID, US passport, or passport card the only permissible forms of ID when voting in person.
findings.note: Legislative update in his House office newsletter (January 2023) describing what HB 458 requires for in-person voting.

findings.passage: This bill will make it especially harder to vote for college students and older Ohioans, both of which are less likely to have current State IDs.
findings.note: Same newsletter; his stated view of how HB 458's ID rules affect college students and older voters. The newsletter also says labor and civil rights groups had filed a lawsuit against the state.
subjects: effect of ID rules on students and older voters
